crossRefs.note: It came to pass, when they had taken them out, that he said, “Escape for your life! Don’t look behind you, and don’t…
Yahweh said to Satan, “Behold, all that he has is in your power. Only on himself don’t stretch out your hand.” So Satan…
Satan answered Yahweh, and said, “Skin for skin. Yes, all that a man has he will give for his life.
Yahweh said to Satan, “Behold, he is in your hand. Only spare his life.”
The ransom of a man’s life is his riches, but the poor hear no threats.
As we labored exceedingly with the storm, the next day they began to throw things overboard.
On the third day, they threw out the ship’s tackle with their own hands.
When they had eaten enough, they lightened the ship, throwing out the wheat into the sea.

parallels.note: Therefore I tell you, don’t be anxious for your life: what you will eat, or what you will drink; nor yet for your body…

translations.web: Life is more than food, and the body is more than clothing.
translations.bsb: For life is more than food, and the body more than clothes.
translations.kjv: The life is more than meat, and the body is more than raiment.
translations.asv: For the life is more than the food, and the body than the raiment.
